metric_definitions.limit_detection: unadjusted daily + stk_limit same-caliber prices; respect ±10% / ±20% / ST ±5% regimes
metric_definitions.failed_limit_rate: fraction with high >= up_limit*0.999 AND close < up_limit*0.999 (NOT high == up_limit)
metric_definitions.promotion_rate: yesterday-limit-up names that limit up again today / denom; mark insufficient_sample when denom too small (never hard-judge attack)
metric_definitions.universe: point-in-time tradable A-share universe each as_of (no survivorship lookback)
metric_definitions.percentile_window: rolling 252 trading days, <= as_of only (no future data)
metric_definitions.csi1000_below_ma20: boolean: CSI1000 close < its 20d MA at as_of; null + data_quality_flag csi1000_unavailable when the index series is missing (the slow-bleed contraction operand)

defense_any_of.exhaustion: promotion_rate <= 0.10 AND net_limit < 0 AND failed_limit_rate > P75_252

contraction_any_of_confirm_2d.earning_effect_gone: promotion_rate < 0.25 for 2 consecutive days AND failed_limit_rate > P75_252
contraction_any_of_confirm_2d.slow_bleed: pct_above_ma20 < 30 for 5 consecutive days AND csi1000_below_ma20

attack_all_of_confirm_3d._note: limit_down_count is a CEILING (min(50, ...)), NOT a floor max(P25,50) — low-risk gates cap, not widen

downstream_action_matrix._status: DOCUMENTED ONLY — NOT wired in comparison-only phase; wired only by a future reviewed production-switch slice
downstream_action_matrix._unresolved_decision: normal defense = no-build vs allow-tiny-position-with-tighter-gates (decide at switch time)
